messages:
Samira (People Ops): Quick draft of a focused "first-week + 30/60/90" checklist for new managers starting next Monday. Short and actionable. Please skim and flag anything missing.

Leo (Hiring Manager): +1. Can we include a tiny stakeholder map they should share by day 5 (who owns infra, security, product, recruiting)?

Alex (Eng Manager): Add 'oncall shadow' and 'verify Redwood Dedicated/GPU quota if applicable' for teams running models. Also recommend limiting meetings first week.

Samira (People Ops): DRAFT (one-pager):
- DAY 0/1: Welcome & access
  - [ ] Google, Slack, GitHub active
  - [ ] SSO/MFA & VPN configured
  - [ ] Redwood Console viewer access; request billing if needed
  - [ ] Add buddy + schedule 1st shadow
  - [ ] Join team channels: #team, #eng, #oncall, #hiring

- FIRST WEEK (practical goals)
  - Day 1: 15m team intro + 15m skip-level option
  - Days 2-5: 30m 1:1s with each direct report (use 30/60/90 template)
  - By Day 5: send 1-slide stakeholder map (infra, security, product, recruiting)
  - End of Week: complete 7-day pulse form (access / role clarity / blockers)

- 2-WEEK GUIDELINES
  - Keep interview load <= 2/day
  - Avoid >4 hours meetings/day; block 1h focus time daily
  - Schedule oncall shadow within 10 days if team runs oncall

- 30/60/90 (prompts)
  - 30d: meet skip-levels, map org, unblock 2 priority tickets, begin interviewing
  - 60d: lead one postmortem or planning session, iterate on team processes, close first hiring loop
  - 90d: deliver Q+1 plan, define 2 measurable KPIs, update onboarding docs for ICs

- WHO TO ASK (Day 1 shortcut)
  - Onboarding: Nina / Samira
  - Infra: Alex (staging access)
  - Security: Mia
  - Recruiting: Leo

- SAMPLE EMAIL (pasteable)
  "Hi team,
  Please welcome <Name> who joins us as <Role> on <Date>. I'll run a 15-minute intro at 10:00 to say hi and share priorities. Please drop a note in #team.
  Thanks,
  <Manager>"

Nina (Onboarding Ops): We'll auto-send the intro email on offer accept if you toggle the flag. Also adding the 7-day pulse to HR reminders.

Alex (Eng Manager): For prod access, require security approval and manager confirmation. Staging RBAC by default.

Leo (Hiring Manager): Can we add 'candidate scorecard completed within 48h' to hiring expectations?

Samira (People Ops): Added. I'll finalize this one-pager and attach to the offer packet tonight. OnboardBot: copied checklist to /docs/onboarding/new-manager-onepager.md

Samira (People Ops): Thanks all 31f. If nothing else, I'll push the final PDF and mark this thread closed.
